description: The five-line snippet to drop into the product's signup or payment handler so it reports conversions to Hustlin with the visitor's tracking code (JavaScript, Swift and curl), plus a venture key for it, minted on demand and shown once. Put the key in the product's secrets as the env var named in the result, never in the repo. Owner only.

label.description: A name for the key, e.g. 'production signup handler'.

mint.description: Mint a new venture key for the snippet and return it once (default true). false returns the snippet with the env var only, for a product that already has a key in its secrets.

name: conversion_snippet
title: Conversion snippet
